name: Diederich Olsen
original_name: ディーデリク・オルセン
source:
In charge of sword training. Once a feared pirate from the country of Shinryu, he is a unique knight who was scouted for his strength. He doesn't take things seriously, but his swordsmanship is top class among knights. Usually drinking when he's not teaching. He doesn't think he's suited to teaching but he's fairly well-regarded by his students.

Likes: Boats, the sea, swords, alcohol, gold
Dislikes: Busy schedules, paperwork.

[Based on [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]
